headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team at the plate, hitting a home run and driving in one run in four at-bats. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 8 batters.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay Rays) who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, and Cooper Pratt (Milwaukee Brewers) who was placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Other players on the injured list include Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers), Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners), Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins), Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians), and Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox).

There were several notable trades and roster movements, including the Miami Marlins trading Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals, and the Athletics acquiring Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins also traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. Additionally, the Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.
